pages.title: Stellar Iron Singularity
pages.text: Star-forged iron compacted into one point. It is the end of fusion, now crushed even further. It is dense and dull grey, and carries a faint warmth from the stellar core where it formed. A compass needle swings toward it from across the room.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stellar iron is where fusion stops. I crushed enough of it in the Singularity Compactor that it collapsed into a single point, the ultimate end of a star's life.
